children: Credit Acceptance executed two financing amendments to strengthen liquidity and extend maturities. The company extended its $500.0 million Term ABS 2019-2 with Wells Fargo Bank, moving the revolving period end date to September 15, 2028 and increasing the interest rate to 5.83% from 5.43%. Separately, Credit Acceptance extended Warehouse Facility II to September 15, 2028 and reduced the pricing spread to SOFR plus 175 bps from SOFR plus 185 bps; $180.0 million was outstanding under this facility as of September 15, 2026. These actions maintain access to non-recourse funding while modestly improving warehouse borrowing costs.
Agreement 1: Credit Acceptance Extends $500M Term ABS 2019-2 to 2028; Rate Rises to 5.83%
: Amendment to asset-backed non-recourse secured financing (Term ABS 2019-2), $500 million
: Extend revolving period and maintain liquidity
Agreement 2: Credit Acceptance Extends Warehouse Facility II to 2028; Spread Cut to SOFR+175
: Amendment to revolving secured warehouse facility (Warehouse Facility II)
: Wells Fargo Bank; Computershare Trust Company
: Extend maturity and improve borrowing costs
